_lisez_moi: Text of the /confidentialite page (set by the Worker, src/routes/pages.js). Same keys as src/contenu/fr/confidentialite.json.
brouillon_faire_relire_par_professionnel: Draft, to be reviewed by a professional. The “To be completed” passages must be filled in before the public launch.
completer_raison_sociale_adresse_contact: To be completed: company name, address, contact for personal data questions.
votre_adresse_e_mail_pour: Your email address, so you can sign in with a one-time code (the code is only kept as a hash, along with the date it was used).
informations_publiques_votre_societe_ann: Your company’s public information (business directory, filed accounts, BODACC), reused for 24 hours. Older copies are no longer used, but are not yet deleted automatically.
reponses_vos_questionnaires_chiffres_que: Your answers to the questionnaires, the figures you enter or upload, and your valuations.
fichiers_que_vous_importez_liasse: The files you upload (tax return, documents, logo, photos) and the generated documents (datapack, teaser, memorandum).
pour_limiter_abus_empreinte_salee: To prevent abuse: a salted, non-reversible hash of your IP address (and, for automated processing quotas, of your user ID), erased by an automatic cleanup no earlier than two hours (two days for quotas) after the period concerned.
chat_expert_cession_n_est: The “Sale expert” chat is not available yet: no conversation is recorded.
avec_qui_vos_donnees_sont: Who your data is shared with
vos_donnees_ne_sont_ni: Your data is neither sold nor shared for commercial purposes. It is processed by:
anthropic_modeles_claude_uniquement_pour: Anthropic (Claude models), only for the processing you request: reading your tax return, reading the pages of your website, drafting the teaser and the memorandum, market research. For market research, Claude searches the web based on your industry, region and business description: do not include your company’s name;
brevo_uniquement_pour_vous_envoyer: Brevo, only to send you the sign-in code and notifications.
si_vous_donnez_adresse_votre: If you provide your website’s address, Passation reads up to eight of its public pages (respecting its robots.txt file).
completer_localisation_donnees_garanties: To be completed: data location, safeguards for transfers outside the European Union, precise retention periods.
depuis_votre_espace_bouton_supprimer: From your space, the “Delete my file” button erases in one go the file, its figures, answers, valuations, documents and all associated files.
il_ne_supprime_pas_votre: It does not delete your account: your email address, your sign-in sessions and the history of your sign-in codes are kept. Account deletion is not yet available from your space: request it at the contact address (To be completed).
vous_disposez_droits_acces_rectification: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. To be completed: contact address. You may lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).
seul_cookie_technique_necessaire_votre: A single technical cookie, required for your session. No advertising or audience measurement cookies. Your browser also keeps, in local storage, the date of the last market research run for your file, with no personal data.
meta_description: How Passation handles your data: what we store, who it is shared with, how to delete it and what your rights are.
